name: coreloom
description: Coreloom is an agentic foundation framework for OctaneJS: a production platform core that teams extend with modules built by AI agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @coreloom/cli build && pnpm --filter @coreloom/cli smoke && node packages/cli/dist/index.js module sync --apply && pnpm --filter @coreloom/platform build
scripts.validate: pnpm coreloom spec validate --all && pnpm coreloom blueprint validate --all && pnpm coreloom module validate
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm format:check
